text: Denser than ayran. Strained, it gives suzma, and dried suzma is kurut; it is also used in the Uzbek chalop soup. The sources do not name the cultures.

processing.text: Boiled milk set in a warm place; the sources do not name the cultures. It keeps 2-3 days cool, then turns very sour.
